```{r}
library(reactable)
# shared.R is already sourced by the filing-note chunk above

senators <- load_senators()
ns       <- senator_name_sets(senators)
votes    <- load_all_votes(ns)

bills <- load_bills() |>
  left_join(senators |> select(name_join, District, Party), by = "name_join") |>
  bill_statuses(votes)

# Each bill's most recent vote (if any), from whichever committee took it.
latest_votes <- bind_rows(votes, .id = "source") |>
  select(any_of(c("source", "Date", "Bill", "Vote", "Result")))

if (nrow(latest_votes) > 0) {
  latest_votes <- latest_votes |>
    group_by(Bill) |>
    slice_max(Date, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(source = COMMITTEE_NAMES[source])
  bills <- left_join(bills, latest_votes, by = c("bill_measure" = "Bill"))
} else {
  # No votes anywhere yet (start of semester): show the columns empty.
  bills <- bills |> mutate(Vote = NA, Date = NA, source = NA, Result = NA)
}

tbl <- bills |>
  arrange(bill_number) |>
  select(bill_number, title, name, status, committee, appropriations,
         Vote, Result, url_slug)

legsim_table(
  tbl |> select(-url_slug),
  page_size = 10,
  columns = list(
    # Numeric underneath (so sorting is 1, 2, … 76), "SB-n" link on top
    bill_number = colDef(
      name = "Bill", width = 90,
      cell = link_cell("SB-", file.path(BILL_PAGES_DIR, paste0(tbl$url_slug, ".html")))
    ),
    title = colDef(name = "Subject", minWidth = 160),
    name = colDef(name = "Author"),
    status = colDef(
      name = "Status", minWidth = 140,
      # Status dot: green = passed, red = dead, gold = moving
      cell = function(value) {
        cls <- if (value == "Passed Senate") "s-pass"
               else if (startsWith(value, "Failed")) "s-fail"
               else "s-active"
        htmltools::tagList(htmltools::span(class = paste("status-dot", cls)), " ", value)
      }
    ),
    committee = colDef(name = "Committee"),
    appropriations = colDef(name = "Fiscal", width = 70),
    Vote = colDef(name = "Latest Vote (A-N-Ab-Abs)", minWidth = 120),
    Result = colDef(name = "Result", width = 85)
  )
)
```
